Meanwhile, sendAddGuestsEmails gates team-member notifications on `if (calendarEvent.team?.members)`, so for this call path the branch is dead code and team members receive no notification. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff: no `team` assignment appears in the constructed evt.

In email-manager.ts, `sendAddGuestsEmails` only notifies team members inside `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { ... }`, so based on the diff alone that branch will not execute for this code path, meaning team-member notifications won’t be sent even when the booking is for a team event.
